meta.title: NiroRoadmap demo
meta.description: A public product roadmap with sample items, votes and comments. Try the Board, List and Timeline views, vote, comment and suggest an idea.
meta.author: nirosuite

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

use NiroRoadmap\Helper\Settings;
use NiroRoadmap\Model\Fields;
use NiroRoadmap\Model\Status_Log;

// Switch on the optional features so visitors can try everything.
foreach ( array(
	'show_target'         => true,
	'show_history'        => true,
	'allow_vote_change'   => true,
	'comments_enabled'    => true,
	'submissions_enabled' => true,
	'submissions_notify'  => false,
	'toolbar_enabled'     => true,
	'view_switcher'       => true,
) as $key => $value ) {
	Settings::update( $key, $value );
}

// Products.
$products = array();
foreach ( array( 'Web App', 'Mobile App' ) as $name ) {
	$term               = wp_insert_term( $name, 'niroroadmap_product' );
	$products[ $name ]  = is_wp_error( $term ) ? 0 : (int) $term['term_id'];
}

// Targets are relative to today, so the demo never looks out of date.
$quarter = static function ( $offset ) {
	$index = (int) gmdate( 'Y' ) * 4 + (int) floor( ( (int) gmdate( 'n' ) - 1 ) / 3 ) + $offset;

	return 'Q' . ( $index % 4 + 1 ) . ' ' . intdiv( $index, 4 );
};
$ago     = static function ( $days ) {
	return gmdate( 'Y-m-d', time() - $days * DAY_IN_SECONDS );
};

// status path (oldest first), product, tags, up, down, fields, comments.
$items = array(
	array(
		'title'    => 'Dark mode for the dashboard',
		'content'  => 'Many of you work late. Add a dark theme to the dashboard that follows your system setting.',
		'path'     => array( 'under-review' ),
		'product'  => 'Web App',
		'tags'     => array( 'Dashboard', 'Accessibility' ),
		'votes'    => array( 42, 2 ),
		'comments' => array(
			array( 'Maya', 'Yes please, my eyes will thank you!', false ),
			array( 'Sam', 'Would love an automatic switch at sunset.', false ),
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Slack integration',
		'content' => 'Post a message to a Slack channel when an item changes status.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Integrations' ),
		'votes'   => array( 31, 1 ),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Export reports to PDF',
		'content' => 'Download any report as a PDF you can share with people who do not have an account.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Dashboard' ),
		'votes'   => array( 18, 3 ),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Two-factor authentication',
		'content' => 'Protect your account with a one-time code from an authenticator app.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Security' ),
		'votes'   => array( 57, 0 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target' => $quarter( 1 ),
			'effort' => 'M',
			'pinned' => '1',
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Custom domains',
		'content' => 'Serve your public pages from your own domain, with HTTPS set up for you.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Integrations' ),
		'votes'   => array( 36, 4 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target' => $quarter( 2 ),
			'effort' => 'L',
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Offline mode',
		'content' => 'Keep working without a connection. Your changes sync when you are back online.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned' ),
		'product' => 'Mobile App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Performance' ),
		'votes'   => array( 24, 2 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target' => $quarter( 3 ),
			'effort' => 'XL',
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'    => 'Team workspaces',
		'content'  => 'Group your projects into workspaces, each with its own members and permissions.',
		'path'     => array( 'under-review', 'planned', 'in-progress' ),
		'product'  => 'Web App',
		'tags'     => array( 'Teams' ),
		'votes'    => array( 68, 3 ),
		'fields'   => array(
			'target'  => $quarter( 0 ),
			'version' => '2.0',
			'effort'  => 'L',
			'pinned'  => '1',
		),
		'comments' => array(
			array( 'Priya', 'This is the one we have been waiting for.', false ),
			array( 'The team', 'Thanks, Priya! A beta is coming in a few weeks. We will post here when it is ready.', true ),
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Faster search',
		'content' => 'Search across everything in under a second, even on large accounts.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned', 'in-progress' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Performance' ),
		'votes'   => array( 29, 0 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target' => $quarter( 0 ),
			'effort' => 'M',
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Push notifications',
		'content' => 'Get a notification on your phone when someone replies or an item is updated.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned', 'in-progress' ),
		'product' => 'Mobile App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Notifications' ),
		'votes'   => array( 22, 1 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target' => $quarter( 1 ),
			'effort' => 'S',
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'    => 'CSV import',
		'content'  => 'Bring your existing data in from a spreadsheet, with a preview before anything is saved.',
		'path'     => array( 'under-review', 'planned', 'in-progress', 'completed' ),
		'product'  => 'Web App',
		'tags'     => array( 'Integrations' ),
		'votes'    => array( 45, 1 ),
		'fields'   => array(
			'target'  => $quarter( -1 ),
			'release' => $ago( 20 ),
			'version' => '1.8.0',
			'effort'  => 'M',
		),
		'comments' => array(
			array( 'Jordan', 'Imported 3,000 rows without a hitch. Great work!', false ),
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Keyboard shortcuts',
		'content' => 'Move around and take common actions without leaving the keyboard.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned', 'in-progress', 'completed' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Accessibility' ),
		'votes'   => array( 27, 0 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target'  => $quarter( -1 ),
			'release' => $ago( 60 ),
			'version' => '1.7.0',
			'effort'  => 'S',
		),
	),
	array(
		'title'   => 'Single sign-on',
		'content' => 'Let your team sign in with the identity provider they already use.',
		'path'    => array( 'under-review', 'planned', 'in-progress', 'completed' ),
		'product' => 'Web App',
		'tags'    => array( 'Security', 'Teams' ),
		'votes'   => array( 39, 2 ),
		'fields'  => array(
			'target'  => $quarter( -2 ),
			'release' => $ago( 100 ),
			'version' => '1.6.0',
			'effort'  => 'L',
		),
	),
);

$total = count( $items );

foreach ( $items as $position => $item ) {
	$days    = ( $total - $position ) * 6;
	$item_id = wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_type'    => 'niroroadmap_item',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_author'  => 1,
			'post_title'   => $item['title'],
			'post_content' => $item['content'],
			'post_date'    => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $days * DAY_IN_SECONDS ),
			'menu_order'   => $position,
		)
	);

	if ( ! $item_id || is_wp_error( $item_id ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	wp_set_object_terms( $item_id, array( $products[ $item['product'] ] ), 'niroroadmap_product' );
	wp_set_object_terms( $item_id, $item['tags'], 'niroroadmap_tag' );

	list( $up, $down ) = $item['votes'];
	update_post_meta( $item_id, 'upvote', $up );
	update_post_meta( $item_id, 'downvote', $down );

	if ( ! empty( $item['fields'] ) ) {
		$clean = Fields::sanitize( $item['fields'] );
		Fields::save( $item_id, $clean['values'] );
	}

	// Walk the item through its statuses, then back-date the history so it reads like a real one.
	foreach ( $item['path'] as $slug ) {
		$status = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'niroroadmap_status' );

		if ( $status ) {
			wp_set_object_terms( $item_id, array( (int) $status->term_id ), 'niroroadmap_status' );
		}
	}

	$log   = Status_Log::for_item( $item_id, 'ASC' );
	$steps = count( $log );
	foreach ( $log as $index => $row ) {
		$wpdb->update(
			Status_Log::table(),
			array( 'created_at' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( $steps - $index ) * 9 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) ),
			array( 'id' => $row->id )
		);
	}

	$parent = 0;
	foreach ( $item['comments'] ?? array() as $number => $comment ) {
		list( $author, $text, $team ) = $comment;

		// A team reply sits under the comment before it.
		$parent = wp_insert_comment(
			array(
				'comment_post_ID'      => $item_id,
				'comment_author'       => $author,
				'comment_author_email' => sanitize_title( $author ) . '@example.com',
				'comment_content'      => $text,
				'comment_approved'     => 1,
				'comment_date'         => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( 3 - $number ) * DAY_IN_SECONDS ),
				'comment_parent'       => $team ? $parent : 0,
				'user_id'              => $team ? 1 : 0,
			)
		);
	}
}

flush_rewrite_rules();
